title: Max Dot Product of Two Subsequences
goal: Maximize the dot product of two equally long nonempty subsequences.
strategy: Prefix DP may skip an element on either side or pair the current elements. Start a new nonempty product at that pair when the earlier diagonal is negative; negative-infinity borders forbid an empty answer.
